scores.tell: Muted lavender-grey stone table is dull against a saturated green and blue scene. Background is as loud as the hero and the hero is the quietest thing. Scene is a bit of a generic, busy palette. Real cards use a bolder hero hue. Hue families are fine, and the real swing card has a similar green and blue setting.

Hero is a single orange-red wood hue on saturated green, which is complementary and loud. The coffin has no neutral rest. The shadow is a plain dark green with little richness. Palette is simple, but the orange is a bit flat and red-pushed compared with the real cards' warmer, more natural browns.

none. Navy body, cream keys and cyan accents sit on a warm yellow field with orange pi marks. Chroma is clear and the hero is distinct from the background. It has a neutral cream rest and cool shadows. It matches the real towel and anchor cards.
